summary: Aldeyra Therapeutics filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, reporting entry into a commercial office lease with Bradford Street, L.L.C. for approximately 4,067 square feet in Concord, Massachusetts, commencing September 1, 2026, through September 30, 2029. Monthly base rent is $12,201 with annual escalations, plus operating expenses and a $50,000 security deposit. The premises will serve as corporate headquarters. This is a routine lease agreement, not a special situation. No strategic, financial, or governance events are involved. The filing merely satisfies Item 1.01 disclosure obligations.
